KCYC Takes on Wellington!

The Kāpiti Coast Youth Council have been investigating Youth Spaces. In this trip we went around Youth Spaces in Wellington. This investigation will help us in our process of creating and improving youth spaces out in the Kāpiti Coast.

http://www.facebook.com/KCyouthcouncil
